assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Three equal 512-pixel-wide columns, each character centered at x=256,768,1280. Every entire body and weapon must stay inside its own column with clear transparent gaps; NO overlaps, no text, no labels, no frames, no scenery, no ground slab, no opaque background or checkerboard. Heads at y=90 and feet at y=930, equal human scale, fully visible feet and weapons. Painterly semi-realistic premium dark medieval fantasy RPG production sprite art, detailed tangible armor and fabric, strong readable silhouette, subtle warm rim light and cool blue fill, natural anatomy.
